title: The Moment
notes: This chapter is one of the manuscript’s tightest symbol studies: rega and pithom are traced cleanly from Exodus through Revelation, and the Babylon–kingdom transfer close is dense and law-positive without padding. Residual presenter staging remains in “Watch them,” “And watch,” and “Take the phrase as a marker,” which undercut the assertive voice. Four author-prose sentences open with And, violating house style. One clause (“every term of the offer reads”) is incomplete and stalls the claim. Surgical fixes to those leave a strong, print-ready chapter.

proposals.old: Watch them arrive in the same verse over the ruin of a land: __“suddenly are my tents spoiled, and my curtains *in a moment*”__ (Jeremiah 4:20).
proposals.new: They arrive in the same verse over the ruin of a land: __“suddenly are my tents spoiled, and my curtains *in a moment*”__ (Jeremiah 4:20).
proposals.rationale: House style forbids presenter staging such as “Watch them.” Assert the arrival of the words instead.

proposals.old: And watch the word do its full work on Babylon herself:
proposals.new: The word does its full work on Babylon herself:
proposals.rationale: Author prose may not start with And, and “watch” is a banned director cue. Assert the action directly.

proposals.old: And Paul, under the weight of real suffering, reaches for the identical word to shrink it: __“our light affliction, which is but *for a moment*, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory”__ (2 Corinthians 4:17).
proposals.new: Paul, under the weight of real suffering, reaches for the identical word to shrink it: __“our light affliction, which is but *for a moment*, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory”__ (2 Corinthians 4:17).
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author-prose sentences starting with And.

proposals.old: And the offer arrives priced in Babylon's own doom-unit: he shows the kingdoms in a *moment* — the very measure by which they fall.
proposals.new: The offer arrives priced in Babylon's own doom-unit: he shows the kingdoms in a *moment* — the very measure by which they fall.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author-prose sentences starting with And.

proposals.old: And if the account can close in a wink, the vocabulary had best be in hand before it does.
proposals.new: If the account can close in a wink, the vocabulary had best be in hand before it does.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author-prose sentences starting with And.

proposals.old: He takes Jesus __“up into an *exceeding high mountain*”__ (Matthew 4:8) and shows Him __“all the kingdoms of the world *in a moment of time*”__ (Luke 4:5) — and by now every term of the offer reads.
proposals.new: He takes Jesus __“up into an *exceeding high mountain*”__ (Matthew 4:8) and shows Him __“all the kingdoms of the world *in a moment of time*”__ (Luke 4:5) — and by now every term of the offer is plain.
proposals.rationale: “Every term of the offer reads” lacks a complement and stalls the claim; “is plain” keeps the density and finishes the sense.

proposals.old: Take the phrase as a marker wherever you meet it: *in a moment*, *suddenly* — when Scripture hangs those words on a kingdom, it is speaking the judgment of Babylon, or a similitude of it.
proposals.new: The phrase is a marker wherever it appears: *in a moment*, *suddenly* — when Scripture hangs those words on a kingdom, it is speaking the judgment of Babylon, or a similitude of it.
proposals.summary: Convert instructional “Take the phrase” into an assertion.
proposals.rationale: House style prefers asserting the case over director cues that tell the reader what to do with the phrase.
